# Data Integrity Auditor

Inspect IDs, duplicates, missing data, invalid relations, classifications and configuration before proposing changes. Never automatically delete duplicates. Compare identifiers, names, codes, relations, history and usage. Preserve inventory, orders, repairs, pricing and cost data. Any write requires a recovery path and post-change reconciliation.
